predictions.prediction_text: Strong gamma peak / sticky zone around 5780–5790 and a pronounced gamma trough/peak cluster around 5840–5850 indicating resistance and sticky behavior there. Heatmap suggests dealers will provide support near 5780–5790 and cap upside around 5840–5850.
predictions.expected_result: If SPX falls to 5780–5790 expect increased dealer support and a high probability (>60%) of a short-term bounce within 1–2 trading hours; if SPX rallies into 5840–5850 expect selling pressure/rejection and failure to break above on first attempt (reversal within 1–3 hours).

predictions.prediction_text: Higher gamma concentration (pinning magnet) near 5990–6010 and a weaker peak near ~6050 implying a magnet that will attract price back toward the 5990–6010 corridor if price moves away.
predictions.expected_result: Expect mean reversion toward 5990–6010 within the trading day, with a high chance (~60%) of price retracing into that corridor before trending beyond it.
